title: NSS Feed Output Format: SaaS Security Activity Logs

blocks.text: The SaaS Security activity Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS) feed specifies the data from the SaaS Security activity logs that the NSS sends to the security information and event management (SIEM) system. You can configure an NSS feed by including one or more fields. The fields and their values display in the NSS feed output.

blocks.item: View a sample SaaS Security activity log.

blocks.text: The following tables display information about the SaaS Security activity log fields and possible values for those fields.
The following are date and time fields:

table: The time and date of the transaction. This excludes the time zone.
The time zone. This is the same as the time zone you specified when you configured the NSS feed.

blocks.text: The following are SaaS Security activity fields:

table: The user who performed the activity
Indicates if the user who performed the activity is an administrator
The SaaS application tenant associated with the activity
The object type associated with the activity
The second object type associated with the activity, if applicable
The SaaS application associated with the activity
The object name associated with the first object type
The object name associated with the second object type, if applicable
The type of activity performed by the user
The event time of the activity
The external owner of the SaaS application
The IP address associated with the activity
